translations.web: There were ninety-six pomegranates on the sides; all the pomegranates were one hundred on the network all around.
translations.bsb: Each capital had ninety-six pomegranates on the sides, and a total of a hundred pomegranates were above the surrounding network.
translations.kjv: And there were ninety and six pomegranates on a side; and all the pomegranates upon the network were an hundred round about.
translations.asv: And there were ninety and six pomegranates on the sides; all the pomegranates were a hundred upon the network round about.
